title: Compose a current-state snapshot service over an adaptive record
statement: The reviewed stronger transition bound composes into joint snapshot-record TV<=min(1,epsilon_init+(m+T/h0) C_imp eta), with no minimum report gap. It covers arbitrary common standard-Borel current-state observation kernels and measurable history-selected bounded Markov controls/times, at fixed paid snapshot count. epsilon_init is a JOINT physical-state/history bound. Between-snapshot path records and path-triggered timestamps are outside this interface.

Acquired baseline position W1 fit, actual physical entropy upper bound and declared amplitude/temperature ceilings
Bounded common Markov force port; for adaptive snapshots, current-state observation kernels, measurable report-driven scheduling and an actual joint physical-state/history preparation bound

assumptions: Fixed torus/dimension, directly thermalized momenta, known gamma/tau and bounded force amplitudes are real input information. No force-derivative bound is assumed.
